futuram.classes.flows

flows.py

This module contains the Flow class.

Classes: - Flow: A class representing a flow of material or energy between two points.

Dependencies: - pandas - matter.py - processes.py

Flow

set_amount(amount)

Sets the amount of material or energy in the flow.

Parameters:

amount (float) – The amount of material or energy in the flow.

Raises:

TypeError – If the amount is not a number.

calculate_amount(model)

Calculates the amount of material or energy in the flow.

Parameters:

model (Model) – The model object to use for the calculation.

set_to(model, process_to)

Sets the destination of the flow to a process object if in the model Adds the process if not in the model

Parameters:

to (str) – The destination of the flow.

set_from(model, process_from)

Sets the source of the flow to a process object if in the model Adds the process if not in the model

Parameters:

from (str) – The source of the flow.

validate_flow(flow, model)

Checks if the flow is valid, i.e. if the composition and the linked processes are valid and in the model

set_composition(composition)

Sets the composition of the flow.

Parameters:

composition (dict) – A dictionary representing the composition of the flow.

Raises:

  • TypeError – If the composition is not a dictionary or if the keys are not strings or the values are not numbers.

  • ValueError – If the sum of the composition values is not equal to 1.

add_to_model(model)

Adds the flow to a given model.

Sets a parameter associated with the flow.

Parameters:

  • parameter_name (str) – The name of the parameter.

  • value – The value of the parameter.

Gets the value of a parameter associated with the flow.

parameter_name (str) – The name of the parameter.

Returns:

The value of the parameter, or None if the parameter does not exist.

has_parameter(parameter_name)

Checks if a parameter is associated with the flow.

Parameters:

parameter_name (str) – The name of the parameter.

Returns:

True if the parameter is associated with the flow, False otherwise.

remove_parameter(parameter_name)

Removes a parameter associated with the flow.

Parameters:

parameter_name (str) – The name of the parameter.

clear_parameters()
